Name: Eek - A mildly startled creature for Custom Companions
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]E[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]EK! wanders the underground, forever discombobulated and startled by the weird noises and creatures around him. In this mod, the farmer can encounter Eek. That's it. (For now).
[/size][/font]
Additional file included to add Eek to your Aquarium. This is optional and not needed for the mod to work.


[color=#3d85c6][size=3][u][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/u]:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Custom Companions
[/list]

[b][u][color=#3d85c6][size=3]COMPATIBILITY:[/size][/color][/u][/b]
No known incompatibilities (tested in save with 500+ mods)

[color=#e69138][b]WARNING:[/b][/color] This mod edits a game map. If another mod edits or makes changes to the same map, this mod may not work.


[color=#3d85c6][size=3][b][u]INSTALLATION[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Download this mod and required dependencies.

[*]Unzip and place into your MODS folder

[*]Play!

[/list]

Original Eek art created by ichortower. Eek is perfeekt thanks to you.

Many thanks to the lovely people on the #Modded-Farmers channel in the Stardew Valley Discord, without whom Eek would have never been released. Special pufferchick squees for server users CeruleanSpadille, Vinillavin, ichortower, Lex (Sydney), and the insomniac. Pufferchick trophies awarded to server users Dr. Elizabeth MathPerson, Ch0opera, and KediDili for helping me keep Eek in one dimension. And thank you to all the others who've provided support.

All donation points earned from this mod will go to the Donation Drive to help the Victims of the War in Ukraine
